title: UI tests take paths from process.cwd(), so they fail under a root-cwd launcher run
outcome: Every UI test that takes its root or file paths from process.cwd() resolves them from its own file instead, so the credited direct Vitest form `node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui`, run from the repository root, passes the whole UI suite, and the full gate's cwd=ui Vitest stage still passes. Test files only; no behaviour change.
acceptance: Every UI test that took its root or a file path from process.cwd() (AgentSessionPanel.virtualization, AgentSessionPanel, plain-text-wrapping, workspace-shell-controls, test-runs-context and test-categories tests) resolves it from its own file location instead, and no ui test source uses process.cwd(); only test files change, with no product behaviour change.
A registered `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui` run from the repository root passes the whole UI suite.
The full gate, whose Vitest stage runs with cwd ui, passes on the landing input.

completion.summary: The six UI tests that took paths from process.cwd() now resolve them from their own file location via import.meta.url. Only test files changed. The whole UI suite passes as a registered root-cwd run (verification 3dc1948c, 296 files / 5158 tests, at master 7317711656696fa95c0ef9663b33489d708b8b21), and the landing FULL test-08b6afb0 passed at the same tree 1695119e. Post-landing re-evaluation delegation-0d1728de (session-18031) passed all 3 criteria.
